guide.factorycore.page.0:
Factory Guide

Build a storage network step by step. No scripts or other mods are needed for storage, hoppers or presets.

Turn the page to start.
guide.factorycore.page.1:
1. First network

Craft a Network Controller (4 iron, 4 redstone, 1 glass) and place it. It belongs to you. Connect blocks with Network Cable; controllers and cables join on all six faces.
guide.factorycore.page.2:
2. Storage

Craft a Storage Drive and a Starter Item Cell. Use the cell on the drive to install it (4 cells per drive). Cable the drive to the controller. Use the drive to see how full each cell is.
guide.factorycore.page.3:
3. Terminal

Place a Storage Terminal on the network and use it. Type to search. Left-click takes a stack; right-click takes half. Click with carried items to store them. Tabs show Fluids, Energy and Jobs.
guide.factorycore.page.4:
4. Hopper to terminal

Place an Interface on the network with nothing in front of it (Buffer mode) and point a hopper into it. It starts in Import when you place it, so hopper items appear in the terminal. Use it to see its contents and settings.
guide.factorycore.page.5:
5. Safe cell upgrades

Open the drive and click a cell's bay with a module on your cursor: Expansion, then Advanced, then Infinite. The cell stays in place and keeps its contents; failures cost nothing.
guide.factorycore.page.6:
6. Machines and presets

Put an Interface against a machine (Machine mode) and use it to set a label, resource, access, priority and rate. On Presets, pick Import, Export or Stock and press Apply: items move without any code.
guide.factorycore.page.7:
7. Power

Fuel Generators burn furnace fuel into FE. Energy Banks on the network store it. Programs, wireless blocks and links all run on FE.
guide.factorycore.page.8:
8. Crafting

Use the terminal grid to craft from storage and encode Blank Patterns. Put patterns in a Crafter and request items in the Jobs view, or use Keep to hold stock.
guide.factorycore.page.9:
9. Processing

Processing Patterns go in a Crafter facing a machine such as a furnace. Jobs send inputs and collect outputs automatically.
guide.factorycore.page.10:
10. Programs

A Program Controller runs simple rules such as keep 64 iron_ingot. Templates help you start. Advanced users can upload Wasm programs. It needs FE and Deploy rights.
guide.factorycore.page.11:
11. Subnetworks

A Gateway's amber cross face is upstream (toward the controller) and its blue dot face is downstream (the subnetwork). Use it to choose what the subnetwork may do and see. Nested gateways only narrow access.
guide.factorycore.page.12:
12. Wireless

Power a Wireless Access Point, bind a Wireless Terminal to it and use the terminal within 64 blocks. Each action costs 64 FE from the handheld.
guide.factorycore.page.13:
13. Links

Use a Wireless Link on a cross or dot face of two gateways up to 256 blocks apart. Sneak-use one gateway, then the other, to pair them. Each gateway needs its own FE.
guide.factorycore.page.14:
14. Progression

Starter: iron, copper, redstone, glass. Expanded: gold, quartz, ender pearls (Expansion Module, crafting, programs, gateways, wireless). Advanced: diamonds, ender eyes, netherite (Advanced Module, links). Infinite: a Nether star.
guide.factorycore.page.15:
15. Speed upgrades

Use Throughput on a port or buffer, then Overdrive. Use Overdrive on both linked gateways. Presets you applied keep running. A busy server can still slow transfers. Capacity upgrades do not change speed.
